# social.image-url — Social preview image is not an absolute HTTPS URL

- **Check ID:** `social.image-url`
- **Default severity:** `warning`; users can override it in `seaworthy.config.json`.
- **Needs:** `html`
- **Standards:** none
- **Source module:** `packages/verify/src/checks/social.ts`
- **Prose page:** [`docs/checks/social.image-url.md`](../social.image-url.md) — embedded below verbatim; write it there, never here.

A social preview image is not an absolute HTTPS URL.

## Why it matters

The sites that build link previews fetch the image themselves, so a relative path means nothing to them, and many refuse plain HTTP.

## What it checks

`og:image` and `twitter:image` must start with `https://`.

## How to fix

```html
<!-- before -->
<meta property="og:image" content="/img/card.png">
<!-- after -->
<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/img/card.png">
```

## Options

None.

## Standards

None.
